alert_summary.rule_name: Role altered to SUPERUSER or CREATEROLE

evidence.statement: SELECT rolname, rolsuper FROM pg_roles ORDER BY rolsuper DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT rolname, rolsuper FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname = 'analyst_ro'

baseline_context.note: Role dba normally returns about 372 rows per simulated day across the 14-day baseline, almost all inside 08:00-17:00.
